title_en: Yang Yuanzhang, Xie Guanchen, Xie Kailin — case of obstructing judicial personnel in performing duties, resulting in fines and detention
keywords_en: civil; obstruction of civil proceedings; first instance; basic people's court; Henan Province; legal person; natural person; Civil Procedure Law (Trial Implementation); ownership of property; determination of obstruction of enforcement; support plaintiff; compulsory enforcement; obstruction of enforcement; seizure of property
full_text_en:
Yang Yuanzhang, Xie Guanchen, Xie Kailin — Case of Being Fined and Detained for Obstructing Judicial Officers in Performing Their Duties

Detainee and Fine Subject: Yang Yuanzhang, male, 66 years old, manager of Henan Province Pingdingshan Housing Development Company.

Fine Subjects: Xie Guanchen, male, 59 years old, deputy manager of Henan Province Pingdingshan Housing Development Company.

Xie Kailin, male, 55 years old, deputy site commander of Henan Province Pingdingshan Housing Development Company.

Because the Fourth Engineering Team of Hubei Province Tongshan County Construction Joint Company (hereinafter referred to as Tongshan Engineering Team) failed to perform a legally effective civil mediation agreement and pay off the outstanding debts for bricks and sand owed to Wei Zhanxun, the Weidong District People's Court of Pingdingshan City, Henan Province, sealed up and then enforced against the property of Tongshan Engineering Team. The above three persons unlawfully obstructed court judicial officers in performing their duties, and the circumstances were serious. The Weidong District People's Court decided to impose detention and fines on them respectively.

At the end of November 1984, the Tongshan Engineering Team signed a construction contract with Henan Province Pingdingshan Housing Development Company (hereinafter referred to as Pingdingshan Housing Company). The contract stipulated: the Tongshan Engineering Team contracted to build dormitory buildings with a total area of over 7,000 square meters for Pingdingshan Housing Company; the project was to be undertaken on a contract basis covering both labor and materials, with a unit price of RMB 118 per square meter; the required materials were to be procured by the Tongshan Engineering Team itself. From November 1985 to March 1986, the Tongshan Engineering Team successively purchased bricks and sand from Wei Zhanxun, a farmer from Zhang Village, Zunhua Township, Ye County, Henan Province, for use in the project, with the purchase price of RMB 3,674.5 remaining unpaid. This gave rise to a dispute, and Wei Zhanxun filed a lawsuit with the Weidong District People's Court. After accepting the case on April 23, 1986, the court, on the basis of ascertaining the facts and clarifying the responsibilities, conducted mediation in accordance with the law. Both parties voluntarily reached an agreement: the Tongshan Engineering Team would pay off the principal and interest of the debt for bricks and sand owed to Wei Zhanxun, totaling RMB 3,757, in a lump sum before May 15, 1986. The Weidong District People's Court served the mediation agreement on both parties on April 26 of the same year, and the mediation agreement became legally effective.

However, the Tongshan Engineering Team neither stated reasons to the court within the time limit nor voluntarily performed the mediation agreement. On May 17, 1986, Wei Zhanxun applied to the Weidong District People's Court for enforcement. The Weidong District People's Court summoned the person in charge of the Tongshan Engineering Team three times, but only its accountant appeared once, claiming that the team had no funds and could not perform. Subsequently, the Weidong District People's Court ascertained that the Tongshan Engineering Team had one concrete mixer, which it had purchased from Xingyang County; and about 2 tons of steel, part of which was purchased from Pingdingshan Housing Company and another part from Ye County and Pingdingshan. For the purchased mixer and steel, invoices or price transfer orders were obtained, financial settlement procedures had been completed, and the Tongshan Engineering Team had already recorded the invoices and price transfer orders as reimbursement vouchers in its accounts. In view of the fact that the team's property was located on the construction site, in order to ensure the smooth enforcement of the mediation agreement, the Weidong District People's Court consulted with the Pingdingshan Housing Company as to whether it could allocate construction funds to the Tongshan Engineering Team to assist in enforcement; this was refused by Yang Yuanzhang and Xie Kailin. The Weidong District People's Court informed Yang Yuanzhang that it would enforce against the property of the Tongshan Engineering Team, and in accordance with Articles 166, 173, and 175 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China (for Trial Implementation), and with the approval of the president of the court, on May 24, 1986, it issued a sealing order to the Tongshan Engineering Team. With the accountant of the team present, it sealed up one concrete mixer and about 2 tons of steel on the construction site; the team was ordered to pay the full amount of the debt to Wei Zhanxun within three days; if it failed to do so by the deadline, the sealed property would be sold to satisfy the debt.

After the sealing measure was implemented by the Weidong District People's Court, Xie Kailin and others from Pingdingshan Housing Company, on behalf of the company, directed the Tongshan Engineering Team to transfer all materials and equipment on the construction site (including the mixer and steel already sealed by the court) to the company. Because the Tongshan Engineering Team still failed to pay Wei Zhanxun the debt by the deadline, on the morning of May 28, 1986, the Weidong District People's Court invited the judicial assistant from the Wutiaolu Subdistrict Office of Pingdingshan City to participate, and dispatched two enforcement officers to the construction site. They informed the accountant of the Tongshan Engineering Team who was present that the court would enforce against the sealed property. The accountant said: "Pingdingshan Housing Company has notified us that all goods on the site have been taken over and now belong to the company." The enforcement officers asked whether there were any handover procedures and whether the project contract had been terminated. The accountant replied: "There are no procedures, and the contract has not been terminated either." The enforcement officers then declared that the sealed property would first be inventoried and taken away, and then the Tongshan Engineering Team and Wei Zhanxun would negotiate on its valuation to satisfy the debt. However, when the court enforcement officers were loading the sealed steel onto a truck, Xie Kailin arrived at the scene and obstructed them, saying: "This is the construction site of Pingdingshan Housing Company, and the steel belongs to the company. I am the deputy site commander. If I say it cannot be taken away, it cannot be taken away. All goods on the site have been transferred to Pingdingshan Housing Company." The court enforcement officers explained to Xie that the company's project was on a contract basis covering both labor and materials, and the court was enforcing against the sealed property of the Tongshan Engineering Team in accordance with the law, which had nothing to do with the company. Xie Kailin refused to listen to the advice.

Because the enforcement work was obstructed, at about 11:00 a.m. that day, the court enforcement officers reported the above situation to the court leadership. The president of the court immediately sent Zhao Chuang, head of the Economic Division, and four judicial police officers to the scene. After hearing the report, they decided to continue the enforcement. When the enforcement officers continued loading the sealed steel, Yang Yuanzhang, Xie Guanchen, and Xie Kailin successively arrived at the scene and continued to obstruct the loading, claiming that the property being enforced by the court belonged to Pingdingshan Housing Company. Zhao Chuang solemnly pointed out: "This batch of property sealed by the court belongs to the Tongshan Engineering Team. Today we are performing official duties in accordance with the law. If you have objections, you may report them to the court president, but you may not obstruct the enforcement." Yang Yuanzhang said: "What level is your president? Even if the president of the Intermediate People's Court comes, he can't take it away! If I say no, who dares to move it?" Xie Guanchen then jumped up and roared: "If you want to take the goods, we'll impound your car! We also have a security office. Whoever dares to move it will be detained!" Then Yang Yuanzhang and others directed more than 50 migrant workers to surround the court enforcement officers, and anyone who spoke was besieged. Xie Kailin organized dozens of people to rush forward in a swarm, unloaded all the steel that had been loaded onto the truck, and immediately transferred it to the material warehouse of Pingdingshan Housing Company. Due to the unlawful obstruction by Yang Yuanzhang, Xie Guanchen, and Xie Kailin, the enforcement work was forced to be suspended.

Afterwards, commissioned by the court, the Henan Provincial Planning and Economic Commission, the Henan Provincial Department of Urban and Rural Construction and Environmental Protection, and the Henan Provincial Branch of the People's Construction Bank of China sent experts and engineering technicians on August 29, 1986, to conduct a demonstration on the issue of ownership of the property subject to enforcement in this case. An "Expert Opinion" confirmed: "The Tongshan Engineering Team, in accordance with the provisions of the 'Construction Contract' and the material settlement procedures completed, should have ownership of the construction materials and machinery it purchased." This was entirely consistent with the court's finding. The assertion by Yang Yuanzhang and others that the property of the Tongshan Engineering Team enforced by the Weidong District People's Court belonged to Pingdingshan Housing Company was completely groundless.

Yang Yuanzhang, Xie Guanchen, and Xie Kailin unlawfully obstructed judicial officers in performing their duties, hindered the normal conduct of civil litigation, and the circumstances were serious, with a very bad influence. On December 14, 1986, in accordance with Articles 77, 78, and 79 of the Civil Procedure Law (for Trial Implementation), and with the approval of the court president, the Weidong District People's Court decided: to detain Yang Yuanzhang for 10 days and fine him RMB 200; to fine Xie Guanchen RMB 200; and to fine Xie Kailin RMB 100. On the same day, the Weidong District People's Court announced the above decisions to Yang Yuanzhang, Xie Guanchen, and Xie Kailin, and immediately handed Yang Yuanzhang over to the Pingdingshan Public Security Bureau for execution of the detention in accordance with the law.
